desc.en: A type of bird that runs around the desert on two legs. It evolved in a peculiar way after eating minerals in the desert when it could find nothing else to eat. Its claws are as hard as steel.
desc.ja: 砂漠を二本足で走る鳥類の一種。食べるものがなく、砂中の鉱物を摂取するうちに独自の進化を遂げた。爪は鋼鉄のように硬い

name.ja: サンドランナーの羽根
